items.title: 67395_Vic Dickenson oral history interview
items.q: We recorded that one damn well I'll tell you that.

ctx.x: I remember Vi telling you it was done -- like recorded for nine hours or something. Straight through.
We recorded that one damn well I'll tell you that. Then we had to leave right after we recorded. Going somewhere way down in France -- I don't know. Or the (inaudible). Maybe we was going to Milan.
